in_latin.name: Lucienne
in_latin.meaning: Lucia, meaning light, derived from Latin lux, light
in_latin.long_meaning: Lucienne, a French variant of Lucia, is derived from Latin lux, meaning light. In Christian tradition, Lucia is associated with the Third Sunday of Advent and is often depicted as a bringer of light in the midst of darkness. The name has been in use since ancient times and has been borne by numerous saints and martyrs throughout history. In modern times, Lucienne has become a popular name among Christians seeking a name that reflects the values of light and hope.
